theorem p2_n001 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (p2v6 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v4 ≤ p2v6)) (h1 : (p2v1 < p2v4)) (h2 : (p2v6 < p2v0)) (h3 : (p2v5 < p2v2)) (h4 : (p2v2 ≤ p2v3)) (h5 : (p2v0 ≤ p2v5)) : (p2v1 < p2v6) := by
  exact @LE.le.trans_lt' Nat _ p2v6 p2v4 p2v1 h0 h1

theorem p2_n002 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (p2v6 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v4 ≤ p2v6)) (h1 : (p2v1 < p2v4)) (h2 : (p2v6 < p2v0)) (h3 : (p2v5 < p2v2)) (h4 : (p2v2 ≤ p2v3)) (h5 : (p2v0 ≤ p2v5)) : (p2v1 < p2v0) := by
  exact @LT.lt.trans Nat _ p2v1 p2v6 p2v0 (p2_n001 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 p2v3 p2v4 p2v5 p2v6 h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5) h2

theorem p2_n003 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (p2v6 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v4 ≤ p2v6)) (h1 : (p2v1 < p2v4)) (h2 : (p2v6 < p2v0)) (h3 : (p2v5 < p2v2)) (h4 : (p2v2 ≤ p2v3)) (h5 : (p2v0 ≤ p2v5)) : (p2v0 < p2v3) := by
  exact @lt_imp_lt_of_le_of_le Nat _ p2v5 p2v2 p2v0 p2v3 h5 h4 h3

theorem p2_n004 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (p2v6 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v4 ≤ p2v6)) (h1 : (p2v1 < p2v4)) (h2 : (p2v6 < p2v0)) (h3 : (p2v5 < p2v2)) (h4 : (p2v2 ≤ p2v3)) (h5 : (p2v0 ≤ p2v5)) : (p2v1 < p2v3) := by
  exact @LT.lt.trans Nat _ p2v1 p2v0 p2v3 (p2_n002 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 p2v3 p2v4 p2v5 p2v6 h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5) (p2_n003 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 p2v3 p2v4 p2v5 p2v6 h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5)
